name: B10-0201/2024 (S&D) – The shrinking space for civil society in Cambodia, in particular the case of the labour rights organisation CENTRAL
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the shrinking space for civil society in Cambodia, in particular the case of the labour rights organisation CENTRAL
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling on Cambodia's government to stop investigating the labour rights group CENTRAL and to drop criminal charges against its programme manager, Khun Tharo. It also asks Cambodia to release activists held on what it calls baseless sentences and to let civil society groups work freely. It urges the European Commission and EU countries to watch Cambodia closely and to review whether Cambodia should keep its special trade access to the EU if labour rights abuses continue.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks Cambodia to act and the EU to review trade benefits.
- **Who it affects:** Cambodia's government, workers and activists, and EU trade policy.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to Cambodia's government, the EU Commission and Council, and the International Labour Organization.
